comment: M4-web webinar resizes (2026-07-15). 26 ready-made banners in two variants: speaker (user uploads an alpha-PNG portrait -> hero_cutout) and visual (LLM metaphor -> App1 hero -> HeroLayer cover). Same layouts; only the hero slot swaps. Geometry calibrated from Figma aZQYa8ye6EQj5WzjXAdQvC node 3517-11450. Palette: Black #222222, Green #26D07C, White #FFFFFF, Yellow/lime #CFF500. Slots: title (webinar title), subtitle (speaker name + role). Fixed labels baked per-format (button 'Зарегистрироваться', badge 'Вебинар', legal footer). WIP: 600x600 first; tile to all 26 after pixel-verify.
